title: You're Allowed to Fall. You're Not Allowed to Stay Down.

scenes.text: You lost the money. You lost the woman. You lost the man you used to be.
And now you wake up every day, wondering how it all fell apart so fast.
Listen to me. Falling is not the end. Staying down is.
Everybody gets knocked to the ground at some point. The difference between the ones who come back, and the ones who disappear, is simple. They got up.
Not with a plan. Not with motivation. Just one small step.
Make your bed. Drink water. Go outside. Do one thing today the broken you wouldn't do. Then do it again tomorrow.
You don't need to win everything back this week. You just need to stop losing to yourself.
The ground is not your home. It's where you start pushing from. So, get up.
